newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randfontein, union reach deal on job cuts.
newsitem.headline: Randfontein, union reach deal on job cuts.

text.p: JCI Ltd said on Wednesday it had reached agreement with the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) on the retrenchment of some 3,500 employees at its Randfontein Estates Gold Mine Ltd, averting the risk of a dispute.

A JCI spokesman said both sides had agreed on the key outstanding issue of severance packages, adding the deal was substantially what had been offered by management earlier this month. The company is already proceeding with retrenchments.
JCI announced on May 28 that it planned to shed a third of Randfontein's 12,000-strong workforce and reduce tonnage throughput as part of a far-reaching restructuring at the struggling gold mine.

Randfontein produced 4,392 kg of gold in the three months to end-March, compared to 5,100 kg previously. It plunged into a 2.86 million rand loss from a 43,83 million rand profit in the preceding quarter.
